goals: Verify that XxxRepository can successfully create, read, update, and delete Xxx entities.
activities: Create a new Xxx instance and save it to the repository
Retrieve the Xxx instance from the repository using its UUID
Verify that the retrieved Xxx instance is not null and is equal to the saved instance
Retrieve the Xxx instance from the repository using its UUID
Save the retrieved Xxx instance back to the repository
Retrieve the updated Xxx instance from the repository using its UUID
Verify that the updated Xxx instance is not null and is equal to the previously retrieved instance
Delete the Xxx instance from the repository using its UUID
Attempt to retrieve the deleted Xxx instance from the repository using its UUID
Verify that the retrieved Xxx instance is null
